description: The Engineered Shift: Stacked supply and demand area chart.
methodology: Data Harmonization: Performed a many-to-one join between the Greater Melbourne Potable Demand dataset and the Desalination Order records. Transformation: Used a 'fold' transform to normalize multiple demand columns into a stackable long format. Layering: Superimposed a semi-transparent 'Buffer' layer (Desalination) over the base demand area to visually represent the engineered gap-filling of traditional catchments.
citation: Melbourne Water, et al. (2025). Melbourne's Annual Water Outlook 2026.
